summary: Retested authenticated APIs, security hardening, and browser regressions. Core API suite passed; lockout and nonexistent-resource 404 behavior passed. Comment persistence is confirmed by API, while the browser check exposed an asynchronous comment-list loading race in the test; CORS preflight still returns wildcard origin.

critical.issue: OPTIONS requests from https://evil.example return 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and wildcard headers, despite configured explicit origins and credentials support.

integration_issues.issue: Comment fetch is asynchronous with no loading state; immediately after opening a task modal the list can display count 0 before the persisted comment arrives. API persistence and eventual backend data are correct.

action_items: Fix ingress/application CORS preflight handling so unconfigured origins are rejected and configured preview origin is returned explicitly; verify no wildcard is emitted with credentials.
Add comment-list loading state or wait for fetch completion before showing the zero-comment state.
critical_code_review_comments: The effective public CORS response contradicts server.py's explicit allow_origins configuration, indicating an ingress or middleware configuration path is overriding the application policy.
TaskModal fetches comments without loading/error handling, so users can briefly see an incorrect empty list and failures are silent.

success_rate.backend: 8/8 core and hardening assertions passed; CORS 0/1
success_rate.frontend: Core login/workspace rendered; comment API persistence verified; full browser continuation blocked by async-list assertion

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_browser_comment_task and one TEST_browser_comment through the browser; temporary test data remains because no task cleanup was requested in the app flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin credentials are admin@northstar.team / Northstar123!. Existing API regression suite is green. Recheck public OPTIONS responses after CORS fix and rerun comment UI with an explicit wait for comment body/count; then finish Members, notifications, board/list, logout, and mobile overflow continuation.
rca of the issue: Public OPTIONS requests are answered with wildcard CORS headers for both trusted and evil origins, so the effective policy is not the explicit configured-origin policy in server.py. Comment persistence works (GET API returned TEST_browser_comment); the browser failure occurred because TaskModal renders the comments container before its useEffect GET completes and has no loading state.
